shared_evidence.text: Owner project: local permission gate. The owner implemented per-module context grants, explicit session activation, and denial tests for requests outside the grant. The notes report working tests, but no external security audit.
Local permission gate design record: source text is untrusted; activation cannot widen a persisted grant. The owner wrote a bounded response-unit path and recorded provenance IDs in returned context.

Owner project: offline source navigator. The owner implemented SQLite full-text search over rebuildable source projections and kept original notes as canonical files. Tests cover deleted-source filtering and citation identity.
Offline source navigator evaluation note: bounded candidate lists improved discovery in local fixtures. The note does not establish a measured user-study gain or production adoption.
Reading note on a third-party graph memory tutorial. The owner studied the tutorial; the record contains no owner-built graph system or evaluation.

Owner project: reproducible sensor data pipeline. The owner wrote ingestion and validation scripts, pinned dependencies, and automated a clean rebuild from source files. The repository includes passing validation tests; deployment scale is not reported.
Pipeline experiment log: input snapshot hashes and run configuration were recorded before execution. A failed run remains in the log alongside the successful rerun.

Owner project: experiment lineage tracker. The owner linked task definitions, dataset hashes, metrics, and final reports; a script checks that an evaluation result belongs to the frozen input. This was used on two internal studies, with no public benchmark claim.
Experiment lineage tracker test note: the checker rejects an edited rubric and reports incomplete attempts separately from quality scores.
Application planning document proposing a future cloud data platform. It is a plan, not an implemented owner project.
Owner-made icon exploration and color palette for a personal app; no retrieval, privacy, or data engineering implementation is described.
Coursework notes on regression and statistical tests. They establish study of these methods, not a completed data pipeline or owner-led study.
Hidden owner project that must never enter the candidate list or an answer.
